articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition System based on Jetson TX2 and Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: With the continuous enhancement of China's comprehensive national strength and the rising sense of well-being of our citizens, reasonable concerns about the hearing impaired in China should also be considered. Yolov5, as the latest work of Yolo series, has shocked the world with its readable code, super high image processing efficiency and simple structure since it came out in 2020. The Jetson TX2 equipped with embedded GPU has the ability to realize more complex and deep neural networks. This paper uses Jetson TX2 and yolov5 algorithm as the core, uses high-definition camera to capture sign language information in real time, and then carries out target extraction and gesture recognition on video frames. The image recognition rate reaches 0.05 seconds per frame, and the average gesture detection accuracy reaches 98%. The experimental results show that the sign language recognition system based on Jetson TX2 and Yolov5 has a high recognition rate and accuracy, which is sufficient to meet the basic sign language communication of hearing impaired people in daily life.

articleTitle: Decision Tree and Hierarchical Cluster Analysis based on Leigh Solves the Problem of Intelligent Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease by Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a neurodegenerative disease that occurs mainly in the elderly population with clinical symptoms including memory impairment, aphasia, and impaired visuospatial skills. In this paper, the data were processed using a mixed interpolation model with MCMC multiple interpolation method LOCF and mean fill method, and Spearman correlation coefficient and binary logistic regression were used to analyze the correlation between Alzheimer's disease diagnosis and various clinical index tests. And then built a decision tree model to intelligently diagnose Alzheimer's disease. A cluster hierarchy analysis was also performed to determine whether the clustering was reasonable for different categories of people. Finally, a temporal prediction model is used to reveal the patterns of the evolution of different categories of populations over time. The study of this problem can better provide physicians with guidelines for early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease and help clinicians better screen potential patients for Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: Traffic Prediction Model of Power Wireless Private Network Based on LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: With the development of ubiquitous Internet of Things technology, more and more power equipment terminals will be connected to the power wireless private network in the future. The network communication quality and network stability will face great challenges. The tension of spectrum resources will be further enhanced. This paper obtains the base station historical traffic data by monitoring the base station service traffic, and then predicts the future service traffic changes in the time, and then adjusts the resource allocation. This paper first analyzes the temporal and spatial characteristics of base station traffic to screen and eliminate the dynamic changes of individual base station traffic in a certain area, then clusters the base station traffic, cluster the base station in the network, and test the same cluster base station data together, build the corresponding cluster data set, combined with LSTM model training, using the maximum value pooling to evaluate the LSTM network model.

articleTitle: Racing with Vision Transformer Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Vision-based reinforcement learning (RL) holds great potential for addressing complex decision-making problems and has benefited numerous research domains, such as game intelligence, medical diagnosis, and autonomous driving. In previous works, deep reinforcement learning (DRL) frameworks combining CNNs and value-based algorithms were applied to Atari games and achieved significant performance. However, exploring these applications further using recent advanced deep models remains an open problem. In this work, we introduce the Vision Transformer <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{ViT})$</tex> model as a feature extraction network in comparison to the traditional CNN model to explore the potential of ViT in RL. The performance of both models is tested in the CarRacing-v0 pixel environment and analyzed in terms of sampling efficiency and algorithmic stability. The results show that <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{ViT}$</tex> brings innovation by utilizing its self-attention mechanism for processing images, which provides evidence that <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{ViT}$</tex> is a promising solution for RL and opens up new avenues for future work.

articleTitle: Fast Detection of COVID-19 Using DL-Based Diagnosis Applying Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: As an RNA-type respiratory virus, COVID-19 has raised our attention that global public health and the economy are under great risk over the past three years. Lately, China is shifting from “zero-COVID” to “living with COVID” by canceling the policy of mandatory centralized quarantine, compulsory COVID-19 ART kit testing and large-scale lockdowns, which may result in healthcare system in China being under severe pressure. Thus, with the increasing demand of auxiliary diagnostic tools, we considered applying a deep learning model to help relieve the pressure of specialized physicians. Application of such advanced artificial intelligence techniques can be of some help during the process of the accurate diagnosis and can also be assistive to deal with the problem of remote villages where specialized physicians are not sufficient. In our study, a new model for detecting COVID-19 with chest X-ray images after prepossessing is presented to triage patients for appropriate testing. Owing to class imbalance, over-sampling to the fewer category is applied to augment the data. Our dataset consists of four classes, namely: coronavirus (COVID-19), Bacterial Pneumonia, Viral Pneumonia and normal lung X-ray image. The architecture we proposed combines channel attention with neighborhood attention in order to achieve higher accuracy in detection of COVID-19 infection. This work achieved some progress of using a novel deep learning-based architecture to efficiently and accurately distinguish COVID-19 from other two kinds of pneumonia.

articleTitle: Detection of Workpiece End Defects Based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The automobile shock absorber is an important component of the automobile, and the metal annular cylindrical workpiece is an indispensable part of the automobile shock absorber processing, so strict quality inspection for the metal annular cylindrical workpiece is particularly important. There are many industrial products. Due to the variety of products and the complexity of the environment, it is still difficult to use a standardized quality inspection method for the quality inspection of these numerous mechanical parts at this stage. For example, the detection method of metal annular cylindrical workpiece studied in this paper is still in the manual quality inspection stage. For the end face detection of annular cylindrical workpiece, this paper combines traditional image processing with depth learning detection algorithm. In order to sharpen defect features, the salient region extraction method based on machine vision is used for circular workpiece, and the workpiece andbackground are segmented to form a depth learning training set. A small object detection algorithm based on convolutional neural network is proposed to significantly improve the detectionindex of workpiece defects.

articleTitle: Traffic Simulation Study with Vissim on Setting of Automated Vehicle Dedicated Lane
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The establishment of dedicated automated vehicle (AV) lanes has been regarded as an effective approach for addressing heterogeneous traffic with both AVs and human-driven vehicles (HV), promoting both traffic efficiency and safety. How-ever, building new dedicated AV lanes in urban areas is not cost effective in the early stage of AV adoption and therefore Micro simulation software package has become an efficient and systematic method to describe traffic dynamics. Different from other literature research methods, the need for dedicated lanes has been innovatively demonstrated for the first time by using simulation studies. Further-more, the effects of different AV penetration rates on traffic flow characteristics under the six-lane background and different positions of the dedicated lanes are considered. Finally, Simulation study on the starting and ending points of weaving area under different traffic flow. It provides a theoretical basis for the design and practice of automatic driving lane for the first time.

articleTitle: Research on Typical SOTIF Trigger Conditions of Autonomous Vehicle Perception Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the intelligence of autonomous vehicles, the safety risks faced by them are gradually increasing, as well as the accidents caused by their potential functional deficiency and performance limitation. The release of the Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) ISO 21448 adds a safeguard to the safety design of autonomous vehicles, which helps to reduce their potential functional deficiencies and trigger conditions and ensure their operation safety. In this paper, based on the perception layer of autonomous vehicles, the trigger conditions of safety of the intended functionality (SOTIF) were analyzed using the system-theoretic process analysis (STPA), including the camera, millimeter wave radar, and LIDAR in the perception layer, and the corresponding trigger conditions were given, which provides some practical reference for the intended function safety analysis and research of autonomous vehicles.

articleTitle: Intelligent Safety Early Warning System for High-Risk Areas Based On BeiDou and STM32
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Aiming at the requirements of safety production, this paper designs an Intelligent Safety Early Warning System for High-Risk Areas based on BeiDou and STM32. The system utilizes the high-precision positioning of the BeiDou Navigation Satellite System, combined with an electronic fence and a sensing technology, to limit the safety grade of different areas for all personnel in high-risk areas, and meanwhile, the surrounding environment, the posture of workers and the like are intelligently detected by using an Internet of Things technology such as a sensor, achieving the role of timely supervision and safety warning, effectively improving the safety of operations in high-risk areas, and enhancing management efficiency.

articleTitle: Using Passive Detection Crowdsensing Technologies In Public Transport
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: We research the possibility of deploying crowdsensing technologies to public transport planning, optimizing, analyzing, monitoring, and measuring. The technologies must be fully compliant with GDPR and other personal information protection regulations. The methods using crowdsensing may replace standard manual counting measurements, becoming an easy, quick, and cost-friendly alternative to the current methods, making these methods outdated. The other aspects of deploying city-wide crowdsensing infrastructure are the possible uses in cases of disease spreading, e.g. Covid19, monitoring mass movement at large public events, and many more. Our goal is to use common wireless technology and use it in a way that is not being scientifically researched at present.

articleTitle: A Study on an Intelligent Drug Delivery Robot Based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: When public health emergency like epidemic breaks out, there is always shortage of medical staff in isolation wards and the risk of infection is high. As for the laborious drug delivery task and the working environment where cross-infection happens easily, a solution is proposed — an intelligent robot car. This paper presents the overall plan and mechanical structure design of the robot: The hardware system is composed of STM32 as the main controller, Raspberry Pi, Iidar, camera and other devices; the robot operating software system is built based on ROS and Raspberry Pi Ubuntu environment; functions include indoor map construction, autonomous path planning, obstacle avoidance and navigation, drug delivery are implemented. The robot runs smoothly and has various and flexible functions, which can provide reference for the development of medical service robots.

articleTitle: Lightweight Underwater Garbage Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOX-S
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the economy and society, the output of garbage increases with it, and more and more garbage flows into water. In order to facilitate multi-platform deployment and extend the detection of underwater garbage, this paper improves on the YOLOX-S algorithm as a lightweight underwater garbage detection algorithm, which has a higher detection speed and detection accuracy while having a smaller number of parameters. Firstly, Shufflenetv2 is experimentally selected to enhance the backbone feature extraction network and reduce the parameters of the model. Secondly, the ECA attention mechanism is experimentally selected to enhance the effective information of the feature map, effectively distinguish irrelevant information in underwater scenes, and improve the capability of detecting different shapes of underwater garbage. Finally, experimental results on the underwater trash image dataset collected in this paper show that the present model has a better balance between speed and accuracy and model size than the mainstream lightweight models, and is more conducive to multi-platform deployment for underwater trash detection tasks. This paper provides a new approach for lightweight underwater garbage detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi Branch Series arc Fault Detection Based on MEEMD and GRU Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The series arc fault poses a maximally threat to the secure of low-voltage system. It is difficult to identify because of the concealment and complexity of arc characteristics. In the cause of effectively identify the cryptic arc characteristics in the current signal and realize the series arc fault detection under multiple branches, a current signal detection approach found on MEEMD and GRU network is proposed. Firstly, an experimental platform is built to collect trunk current signals of branch arc fault under different conditions. Then, the current signal is disintegrated by MEEMD and the training data set and test data set are constructed. The modified GRU network model is applied to identify the arc fault and output the detection results. The experimental results show that the arc fault detection accuracy based on MEEMD-GRU method is 97.28%, which has higher detection accuracy compared with the LSTM model, GRU model and MEEMD-LSTM model. The research has good detection results for series arc fault under multi-branch and provides reference for subsequent research.

articleTitle: Design of Gesture Recognition System Based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: As a new type of human-computer interaction, gesture recognition has gradually become an important research direction in the field of smart city construction. The traditional gesture recognition system relies on various types of sensors, which has high requirements for hardware and application environment. The recognition accuracy will be affected by the accuracy and service life of electronic components. Therefore, there is an urgent need for natural and easy-to-understand, people-oriented new recognition technology based on computer platform. The OpenCV used in this paper is an open source computer vision library, which contains a wealth of image processing algorithms, which can be easily and quickly applied to gesture recognition systems. This paper makes a complete exploration of gesture recognition system based on OpenCV. Firstly, this paper studies the advantages and disadvantages of different skin color models for skin color detection, and selects a skin color model that is robust in both normal indoor environment and strong light conditions. Secondly, the gray image segmented by skin color is morphologically processed, and the contour frame of gesture information is taken by Fourier descriptor algorithm to obtain the position and boundary information of hand skin color region. Then, this paper extracts and calculates the characteristics of the collected data, and uses the support vector machine algorithm to analyze the gesture recognition of the image captured by the camera. Finally, the above research modules are effectively collected, and the graphical interface is written by PyQT5 for human-computer interaction. The system design framework and the specific process of implementing the system are given. Then a relatively complete experiment was carried out on the system to verify the accuracy of the recognition.

articleTitle: Research on End Face Defect Detection of Small Sample Workpiece Based on Meta Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In traditional recognition methods based on convolutional neural networks, the focus is on improving recognition accuracy and real-time issues, both of which depend on large- scale datasets, but ignore the issue of unbalanced datasets. This extreme imbalance in the sample set can cause the model's performance to collapse. While transfer learning can fine-tune existing pre-trained models using small-scale datasets, there is still a significant challenge in transitioning from small-scale (hundreds of sample data) to a few samples. We use the defect of car shock absorber parts as a carrier to explore intelligent few-sample recognition methods, using meta-learners to learn meta-features to achieve knowledge transfer and then guide the detector's recognition of new classes. There are still many issues to be resolved in the use of few-sample learning for practical recognition tasks. This paper proposes a generalized few-sample wheel defect recognition method based on meta-learning, using a target detector equipped with a predictor reconstruction network. The effectiveness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOX Algorithm based on Structural Re-parameterized CBAM for Wild Animals Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: We use the structural re-parameterization method to optimize the generation process of the attention map. CBAM has long been among the most widely used attention techniques because of its simplicity and superior performance. The success of RepVgg shows great application potential of the structural re-parameterization methods, which we notice that could be used to further strengthen the ability of the CBAM. Based on YOLOX, we evaluate our method on a self-built wild animals' dataset. The result shows better performance compared to the original CBAM. Notably, the gain is FREE OF CHARGE. Compared to the baseline model, no extra parameters or FLOPs are introduced during the inference stage. Experiments prove that it is feasible to apply the idea of structural re-parameterization in the generation process of attention mechanism. The proposed method shows great application potential on wild animal detection task.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Monitoring System for Greenhouse Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for high-quality vegetables, greenhouses play an important role in the cultivation of modern agriculture. In order to realize remote intelligent monitoring of environmental parameters in greenhouses, this paper designed an environmental monitoring system of agricultural greenhouses based on the Internet of Things, which realized remote monitoring of environmental data in greenhouses and control functions of executive organs, aiming at problems such as low efficiency, high cost and weak real-time of manual inspection of traditional greenhouses. Through Zigbee wireless acquisition gateway and Zigbee wireless sensor node, real-time data acquisition and monitoring of environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity and light intensity in the greenhouse are carried out, and the data is uploaded to the administrator's mobile phone and remote monitoring platform. The system can carry out automatic control of related equipment, query, display, alarm and other functions of real-time data and historical data. Make the greenhouse crops can grow in a suitable environment. The practice shows that the greenhouse monitoring system can realize the real-time monitoring of environmental parameters of the greenhouse, is conducive to improving the stability, reliability and efficiency of the greenhouse, provides a solution for the remote monitoring of environmental information of the greenhouse, and plays a certain role in promoting the automation and intelligent construction of agricultural production.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm for Arterial Road Signal Coordination Control
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In this paper, the traditional algorithm of arterial coordination control is analyzed in depth, and the shortcomings of the traditional algorithm are pointed out. A modified method for calculating the width of green wave bandwidth, a method for calculating the phase shift of intersection signals, and a method for matching the real intersection with the ideal intersection are proposed. The analysis shows that the improved algorithm can achieve the best match between the real intersection and the ideal intersection, and the calculated green bandwidth width and signal phase shift of each intersection are more accurate.

articleTitle: Location Selection of Continuous Multi-logistics Nodes Base on Node Covering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In order to relieve ground traffic congestion and reduce logistics costs, this paper studies the location problem of continuous multi-logistics nodes based on graph theory, computer technology, and optimization theory. Based on the data of the 14th China Postgraduate Mathematical Contest in Modeling of “Huawei Cup”, this paper solves the location problem of continuous multi-logistics nodes in three steps. Through a self-designed node coverage algorithm based on the PageRank algorithm and greedy strategy, under the constraints of smooth ground and high node utilization, a total of 18 logistics nodes (including 8 first-level nodes and 10 second-level nodes) are determined for the underground logistics network. The spatial location, coverage, actual freight volume, and transshipment rate of primary nodes) are solved. Finally, a strategy for solving the location problem of continuous multi-logistics nodes is constructed.

articleTitle: Collaborative Architecture of Wide Area Natural Disaster Observation System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Heterogeneous systems” collaboration strategy is important for natural disaster observation. In this paper, we discuss the collaborative architecture of integrated observation system using satellite remote sensing, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V$</tex> nmanned swarm system, Internet of Things (IoT), and Geographic Information System (GIS) technologies. We concern three issues: inter-domain and intra-domain systems' collaboration mechanisms, heterogeneous communication network, and system function modularization. On the base of the proposed architecture, we perform a series of satellite and UAV remote sensing and modeling experiments, then we develop a data visualization system based on GIS and observed data. We propose an unmanned swarm observation algorithm and perform a series of simulation experiments, also we develop an initial end-edge-cloud system for unmanned swarm observation. The proposed architecture provides better system scalability in complex emergency environment.

articleTitle: Where and What We Should Look at: A Cross-Modal Fusion Method with Attention for Object Counting
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Object counting is a challenging computer vision task. Recent studies find that incorporating multi-modal information can help find the hard points. But the cross-modal representation learning, which aims to comprehend and represent the information in various modalities, is still far from being fully explored in this area. The current works fail to model the dynamic complementary relationship between different modalities, leading to incomplete information extraction. To make up for that, we propose an attention mechanism to facilitate information fusion. Our work adopts a three-stream structure as the framework, consisting of two modality-specific branches and one modality-shared branch. The proposed two attention modules aggregate contextual statistics along the channel and spatial dimensions to generate attention maps that reflect the features' importance in various modalities. In this way, the complementary relationship between different modalities would be exposed to our model precisely. Besides, we share the convolution filters of the attentions modules between the RGB branch and modality-shared branch. The modality-common statistic can be captured through parameter sharing, exposing the informative features. To validate our ideas, we implement extensive experiments on the RGBT -CC benchmark. Consequently, we outperform the state-of-the-art results by a large margin. The performance strongly supports the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Design and Construction of Magnetostrictive Harvester for Gait Monitoring of Human Actives
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In this paper, we presented a new structure of a magnetostrictive energy harvester, which has a short-time impact piezomagnetic effect and can generate electricity during human walking. The harvester utilizes the hybrid magnetostrictive/electromagnetic effect, which helps to enhance its piezomagnetic effect in TbDyFe Alloy (magnetostrictive material). Also, an air gap is designed to improve its harvesting effect, which exhibits a larger numerical variation of magnetic field and impact stress, helping to generate more electricity. A prototype of a magnetostrictive harvester with a basic magnetic field and suitable air gap is configured, and its harvesting effect is calculated. The distribution nephogram of magnetization is analyzed, the magnetic density in the TbdyFe Alloy are calculated, and the optimized length of the air gap is determined. Then, we fabricated a prototype of the harvester, its harvesting effects are tested and calculated. The proposed structure shows a larger induced voltage for impact situations, which can generate up to 0.5-8V peak value for different impact vibrations. Also, the presented harvester can be safely used in the situation of low-frequency human walking (about 600N with 7.6MPa stress) and faster human running (about 1850N with 23.6MPa transient impact), which is suitable to be used for the application of gait monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Study on Layout and Characteristic Analysis of Highway Tunnel LED Based on Visible Light Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The communication system in the tunnel environment should not only realize the operation and scheduling of cars and trains, but also provide passengers with services such as telephone, work and office. However, conventional RF communication technology was faced with the defects of increasing communication cost and less and less frequency spectrum resources. The optical communication with high speed modulation and green illumination has become a hot topic for wireless communication. In this paper, the optimized the layout of LED light as the source for visible light communication was applied to improve the performance of tunnel communication system. First, the transmission model of visible light communication system combined with the actual environment of the tunnel was analyzed, and then the layout scheme of LED was designed fit with the spatial structure characteristics for the tunnel. The last, MATLAB was used to simulate and analyze, Simulation results showed that uniform illumination distribution was obtained to meet the lighting requirements of the system and performance of the tunnel communication system. In this paper, the MATLAB mathematical modeling software was used to simulate the layout of the light source, explore the best communication effect under different layout, laying a foundation for the stable communication of tunnel visible light.

articleTitle: Using RF Generator As A Renewable Energy Source For Green Building Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Renewable energy is one of the key driving forces behind the mass deployment of the internet of things and wireless sensor networks as a trade-off to reduce the dependence on batteries as a major source of energy. This work proposes the use of an RF generator as a potential source of renewable energy for low-power embedded and electronic devices for smart building applications. In our experiment, we designed and implemented a power management module for a mobile intermittent computing wireless temperature sensor device using energy-efficient software and hardware frameworks. Experimental results shows that our proposed energy source can provide wireless energy for low-power devices using our proposed power management circuit to boost operating voltage from 1. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{8V}$</tex> to 5. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{8V}$</tex>. Also, using our proposed software framework to develop an intermittent computing system shows significantly improved performance efficiency by a delta of 270% which can be used to develop other ultra-low power embedded devices.

articleTitle: A Case Study of Starlink and 5G in Future Space based Internet Services
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: As early as the 1980s, the US Department of Defense (DOD) proposed the deployment of small satellite constellations on near -ground orbit to perform military tasks such as communication, reconnaissance, and early warning. However, due to the high launch costs, many low -orbiting military satellite projects represented by the “Space Tracking and Surveillance System” (STSS). In recent years, the cost of space launch transportation has continued to decrease, and the US defense department has also proposed low -orbiting military satellite Internet projects such as “Black Jack” and “National Defense Space Strang” (NDSA). In this work, we discuss the use of Starlink and 5G in the future space internet services, comparison of the two major style is discussed for the future utilization of 5G and beyond.

articleTitle: China's Electric Vehicle Development Strategy from a Smart City Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Smart and low-carbon urban development requires the government to pay attention to the development of electric vehicles. To promote the development of electric vehicles toward digital management, this study analyzes three stages of electric vehicle development: sales, operation, and battery recycling. Based on expert research and the actual situation of electric vehicle development in China, this study identifies the “vehicle and battery separation” sales strategy, which is a management method to increase electric vehicle ownership by reducing the pressure on vehicle owners to purchase vehicles. In addition, the researchers propose an operational model for the interaction between transportation system networks and electric system networks using blockchain and Vehicle-to-grid (V2G) technologies. This model helps to enhance the digital management of future electric vehicles. Finally, the researchers propose four recycling strategies for power battery echelon utilization strategies. They can not only improve the efficiency of electric vehicle batteries but also increase the revenue of grid companies.

articleTitle: Smart Delivery Boxes for Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Smart Cities are an evolving concept of a set of technologies contributing to the overall simplification of processes within the city using the Internet of Things. This topic is more relevant now than ever before thanks to the availability of such technologies to the general public and low initial costs. We research the possibility of using Smart Delivery boxes to create more effective last-mile delivery services while reducing costs and protecting the environment at the same time. Our calculations show considerable benefits to both society and the environment. The research was done for the Czech Republic and the Czech postal operator - the Czech Post.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Model of Parking Space Dynamic Guidance Based on Multi-Source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Urban parking space sharing is one of the methods to solve the problem of urban parking, and parking guidance system is an effective way to improve the level and efficiency of urban parking management. At present, there are some disadvantages about the parking space prediction method, such as the lag of dynamic real-time data feedback, and the difficulty of automatic adjustment of prediction data. Therefore, the paper proposes to adopt the method of multi-source data fusion prediction, integrate the relevant data series, and make full use of the historical and real-time parking forecast data for automatic adjustment and real-time update. The comparison and analysis of the prediction data show that this method can comprehensively and timely predict the dynamic parking space data from multiple perspectives compared with the traditional single data prediction method, thus improving the accuracy and efficiency of the prediction data to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimization of Bus Organization for the High Speed Railway Station Feeder Bus Facing the Demand of Watching Games
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In order to promote the construction of the intelligent transportation system and promote the healthy development of the city, this paper studies the organization optimization of the event mode high-speed rail feeder bus, and proposes an optimization method of the feeder bus organization considering the high-speed rail timetable. This study establishes a Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) model with the goal of comprehensive optimization of bus company operating cost and passenger service quality. Through organizational optimization, demand responsive event mode feeder bus can effectively alleviate the problem of passengers waiting for buses for a long time while meeting the travel demand during the event.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Mechanical CAD Model Base System for Experimental Platform Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In this paper, a knowledge base model and a reasoning control system were designed by using neural network principle and BP algorithm derivation process in combination with the characteristics of university experimental platform, and the frame structure of mechanical CAD system of the whole experimental platform was constructed. Then, based on the case study of virtual simulation experiment of CAD model base system for automatic assembly of laboratory products, the rationality and effectiveness of applying feedforward neural network and BP algorithm to CAD system of experimental platform were verified, and the automatic design of mechanical products was realized. The research on the application of virtual simulation experiment CAD model base can provide reference for the construction and application development of laboratory platform of smart city universities in China.

articleTitle: A Cloud Native Zero Trust Full Process Video Image Authentication Encryption Method to Protect Video Data Security
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: With the popularity of video data applications, malicious tampering against video information and data theft are on the rise. In the face of increasingly frequent video data security threats, research and development of effective video data protection technology has become an important development direction for network and information security strategies. Therefore, this paper investigates a cloud-native zero-trust video encryption method for protecting video data security. The uncertainty of chaotic system results can be better combined with video encryption. This paper constructs a key system with double PWLCM chaotic mapping on the cloud-native platform, based on the zero-trust principle, to encrypt video, protect video data security and achieve zero-trust security of the system. This paper first introduces the basic concepts of chaotic encryption algorithm design ideas and multi-level encryption schemes, followed by the design of video encryption schemes and finally the analysis of encryption efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of Mask Detection System based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Object detection technology is a hot direction of advanced vision research and the core technology of computer vision. The existing target detection system has the disadvantages of single detection object, slow detection speed and large computer space occupancy rate. Deep learning can make the computer have strong self-learning ability and effectively make up for the shortcomings of traditional detection methods. Aiming at the requirement of wearing masks in public places under the normalization of epidemic prevention and control, this paper designs a mask detection system based on deep learning. Because yolov5 algorithm is a better algorithm in the field of deep learning at present, the advantages of this algorithm are high recognition rate, low false alarm rate, high work efficiency, easy to read code and convenient format conversion, so the mask detection system is designed and implemented based on yolov5 algorithm. By analyzing the features extracted from the real-time target detection network, the target detection model is tested by using the training model of computer vision. The results show that the target detection system based on deep learning has high accuracy and can meet the design requirements.

Author Keywords: Deep learning Yolo algorithm Mask detection Computer vision

articleTitle: “Artificial-Intelligence-Driven Management” Supports and Utilizes Smart Homes and Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: “Artificial-Intelligence-Driven Management” replaces the information-based management and decision-making processes represented by the Deming Cycle with the Artificial Intelligence-empowered Plan-Predict-Act Cycle. General-purpose and collaborative LeanBots use this paradigm shift to perform cyber-secure, sophisticated decision-making processes autonomously and in real-time at large scale, low costs, and with minimal energy consumption. Collaborative LeanBots reduce human-induced security risks or habitability requirements, and also eliminate human cycle times, costs, and efforts to perform sophisticated decision-making processes. When connected to supply chains and value streams, LeanBots become part of automation and logistics domains, additionally receiving or delivering goods and services. Collaborative LeanBots can be used by non-professionals and experts in general and proprietary environments. Furthermore, LeanBots can be deployed with a wide range of standard and proprietary devices or as software services, supporting centralized, decentralized, redundant and dispersed installations in smart home, building, city, and factory environments. LeanBots also contribute to the distribution of system intelligence. StockExBot is an application-specific LeanBot that takes equities as objects and earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) as the target for its cyber-secure and autonomous decision-making processes. Collaborative StockExBots that are already operational and hardened, can decisively accelerate the design, verification, validation, ramp-up, and roll-out of alternative LeanBots. Customer relation management (CRM) and supply chain management (SCM) can be an appropriate starting point to identify those with maximum impact on local and global scales. The range of feasible applications of this new, unique and universally applicable technological platform, in combination with economies of scale can have a significant impact on the attractiveness of an entire economic region.

articleTitle: A Cloud-Native-Oriented AI Epidemic Four-Color Situation Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Aiming at the prevention and control of epidemic diseases in the community, a four-color situation decision support system for cloud native is proposed, Through a single situation prediction algorithm and comprehensive situation prediction, the cloud native AI epidemic prevention and control four-color situation decision support system is realized. Taking cloud native as the technical base, based on the environment of microservice+Kubernetes+container, the system first adopts a two category learner to solve the multi category problem model, Finally, the performance evaluation of the trained model on the test set has achieved an ideal result; At the same time, based on the stack generalization model, the integration of four prediction models is realized, including the aggregation degree of high-risk personnel, regional mobility, the aggregation degree of regional key sites, and the epidemic prevention and control support capability. In order to control the spread of the epidemic, we have predicted how the virus will spread based on environmental conditions in a variety of ways, and optimized the allocation of medical resources.

articleTitle: Transmission Optimization Algorithm Based on ROS Nodes in Robot Teleoperation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Due to the complexity of remote unstructured environments, it is critical to establish reliable and efficient communication between the operator and the robot in robotic teleoperation. However, in the reality of using wireless networks for communication, there are problems of variable latency, message jitter, and intermittent network outages that affect the performance of teleoperation. To address this problem, an optimization algorithm that applies a combination of dynamic priority scheduling and congestion control is proposed based on the implementation of ROS client nodes for message transmission queues to reduce delays, jitter, and the occurrence of congestion in data exchange and improve teleoperation performance. Through qualitative and quantitative experiments, this solution was compared with existing open source solutions, and the results showed that this solution achieved better results in all test cases, provides a new and effective solution for robot teleoperation enhancement.

articleTitle: An Investigation on Effects of Indoor Temperature and Lighting on Environmental Interaction Perception and Heart Rate Variability Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: People perceive the indoor environment through interacting and integrating various sensory organs. Sixteen volunteers were recruited for an experimental study investigating the cross-effects of temperature and light on environmental perception. The experiment was designed with three independent variables: indoor temperature (24°C, 26°C, and 28 °C), illuminance (100 lx, 300 lx, and 500 lx), and correlated color temperature (CCT) (3000 K, 4000 K, and 6500 K). Subjective questionnaires and heart rate variability (HRV) were used to evaluate volunteers' perceptions of the different indoor thermal-lighting environments. The results show that temperature and CCT have significant effects on thermal sensation. Temperature, illuminance, and CCT have significant second-order effects on thermal sensation. The bright sensation was significantly affected by illumination, and different temperatures affected the sensation of the same illumination. Lighting comfort is significantly affected by CCT, but the temperature has no significant effect on lighting comfort. Environmental perception classification models using SVM and DT algorithms with physical environment parameters and volunteer heart rate variability metrics are established, and all three voting accuracies are above 84%. The established models can be used to provide dynamic regulation strategies for the indoor environment of intelligent buildings.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Deep Neural Network Model Protection with Key and Backdoor Watermark
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Deep neural network (DNN) has achieved great success in many fields. However, as training a good model often needs massive high-quality data and computation resources, it is very important to protect the intellectual property (IP) of neural networks. We find that the relevance of preventing the stealing of the learned DNN is the same as verifying the suspicious model. In this research, we proposed a novel method to watermark Deep Neural Networks and authorize specified users. Specifically, the input must go through a watermark network with our designed backdoor and key network before it can be put into the target network. Experiment results demonstrated that our method is effective in extracting watermark and preventing infringement without affecting the performance of the target network. Our proposed protection network has achieved excellent results in the ability to identify the triggered set and the non-trigger set, the ability to identify the key, and the quality of the output of watermark.

articleTitle: Method for Chunking and Managing Large Urban Road 3D Point Cloud Maps based on Voronoi Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The urban road scenario is one of the main scenarios for autonomous driving. The chunking and managing of large 3D point cloud maps in this scenario are essential to solving the memory occupation and memory fluctuation problems caused by map loading in the process of autonomous driving localization, sensing, and planning. This paper proposes a method for chunking large urban road 3D point cloud maps based on Voronoi graph, which achieves uniform and efficient chunking of the maps in this scenario and effectively preserves the semantic integrity of the maps at roads and junctions. At the same time, this paper presents an efficient and applicable map dynamic management method for the autonomous driving localization process, significantly reducing the memory footprint and fluctuations during map loading. We experimented our method extensively on the KITTI dataset. It achieved uniform chunking of the point cloud coverage area and the number of point clouds on a large urban road laser point cloud map covering an area of 3.5km*3.5km, respectively. The memory footprint was reduced by 16% compared to existing map dynamic loading experiment methods.

articleTitle: Analysis of DF-GAN-based Text-to-Image
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Adversarial generation network is widely used in the field of text generation image. Complex, detailed image generation can be a good way to improve the work efficiency of relevant industry practitioners. In the aspects of poster and art design, generating images according to the given text and language description can greatly improve the work efficiency of the design industry staff, and replace them to carry out ordinary and general work, so that the labor force can be liberated from the boring work and carry out more creation. Compared with the previous network models, the generator structure of the latest DF-GAN model is more simplified, which can generate high-resolution images, and the text and image match well. Therefore, in this paper, DF-GAN, a new added-generation network model proposed recently, is firstly selected to reproduce the model, and the test results of the model are evaluated by FID and generated images, and the optimization effects of DFBlock generator, MA-GP target discriminator and other components on the model are analyzed. Secondly, we tried to optimize the model results from the aspects of increasing training times and modifying data sets. Finally, the advantages of the model in semantic consistency are verified by comparing the results of text word order switching. According to the final results, DF-GAN does show a more accurate and clear effect in the generation of coarse-grained bird images, and the semantic consistency is well verified.

articleTitle: Real-time Vehicle Pose Estimation Based on Nonlinear Optimization and Probability Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Parking AGV is more and more widely used in efficient automatic parking, and one of the serious challenges that parking AGV faces is vehicle pose estimation. The existing algorithms for vehicle pose estimation rely on the contour information of the vehicle body, and sensors are usually installed at a higher position such as the top of the vehicle and the vehicle body. However, as the parking AGV only grabs the wheels and the sensor is always installed at a lower position, we can only obtain wheel information and limited body information. In this paper, a new pose estimation method based on probability residual model of wheel point cloud is proposed. Firstly, we use RANSAC to remove the ground points, use the z-axis dichotomy to segment the vehicle body points and wheel points, and get the minimum circumscribed rectangle from the wheel point cloud to obtain a rough estimation of vehicle pose parameters. Secondly, we use gaussian distribution model to build our own wheel probability model. Then, we use trilinear interpolation and residual model established by ourselves to calculate the score and gradient of probability on the wheel probability model, and take vehicle pose parameters roughly estimated by the minimum circumscribed rectangle as the initial value, accurately estimating the vehicle pose parameters through the nonlinear optimization gradient descent method. At last, we compare our method with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{FPFH}+\text{ICP}$</tex> method in terms of registration accuracy and registration time. Our method reach 100% recall around RMSE <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$=0.0132$</tex>, and the average cost of time to pose estimation for each frame is 12ms, 1/27 average cost time of method <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{FPFH}+\text{ICP}$</tex>, performing robustly and efficiently in vehicle pose estimation.

articleTitle: Situation Awareness on Blockchain Based on Markov Game Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Aiming at the network security problem of the blockchain system, the game model based on Markov is proposed. The model perceives the network security situation of the blockchain system, accurately and comprehensively evaluates the current security status of the system through clustering screening and attack game, dynamically evaluates the security situation of the system, and establishes an attack transfer network and the best reinforcement scheme. The experiment shows that the Markov game model based on 51% double spend attack can evaluate and predict the current and future security status of the blockchain system, and can reduce the asset loss caused by blockchain attacks to a certain extent.

articleTitle: MCAMNet: A Novel Encoder-Decoder Network with Multi-directional Convolution and Attention Mechanism for Crack Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Accurate and timely detection and repair of pavement cracks is the key to road maintenance. Although the crack detection method based on image semantic segmentation have achieved good results till now, there are still some shortcomings, especially detection accuracy needing to be further improved. We propose a new network for crack segmentation based on encoder-decoder structure, called MCAMN et, which uses multi-directional convolution module instead of conventional convolution module for feature extraction, solving the problem of discontinuous and incomplete crack segmentation results. MCAMNet innovatively adds spatial attention block and efficient channel attention block after the encoder to reduce the interference of background and noise, solving the problem that the crack details and the segmentation results of small cracks are not fine. Additionally, we mix three loss functions of different levels by obtaining a mixed loss function to supervise the training process of MCAMNet, solving the problem of rough and fuzzy crack edges in the segmentation results. Experiments on four public datasets of pavement cracks prove that the F -score and mIo U of MCAMNet are better than existing methods.

articleTitle: PortalEyes: A Portal Identification Method via Noisy Video Traffic
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: As a new mode and new concept of modern city operation and governance, smart city has long-term significance for optimizing urban resource scheduling, improving urban operating efficiency, and improving the quality of life of citizens. As more and more citizens rely on video platforms(such as YouTube) for entertainment and information acquisition, media construction centered on video platforms has become an indispensable and important part of smart city, so the improvement of video service quality is becoming increasingly important. However, in the process of watching the video, the video portal and the video resource are transmitted separately, and it is difficult for the network providers to infer the portal (that is, the user's access intention) through the video resource. This paper abstracts the problem into the association of video resources and portals, and proposes PortalEyes, a portal identification method that combines co-occurrence relationship mining and order embedding, which quickly and roughly screens a large amount of traffic generated by users then sorts the screened results to further improve the accuracy. We conducted extensive experiments and compared the baseline and classic sorting algorithms. Our method makes the average position of the portal to be 1.2, which is the best compared with these algorithms. The experimental results show that our method is helpful for user intent discovery. It is of great significance to help Internet providers improve the quality of video services and improve the efficiency of information acquisition in smart cities.

articleTitle: A Trend of 2D Human Pose Estimation Base on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The research on Human pose estimation remains the most fundamental and challenging problem in computer vision. In this context, computer vision-based automobile safety-assisted driving technology has received comprehensive attention and is widely used in automobile-assisted driving systems. Powered by advanced artificial intelligence, the scale of data to be learned by deep learning networks is increasing, the processing tasks are becoming more and more complex, and the model parameters are also increasing. In the field of distributed parallel computing research has also received extensive attention. In this work, we focus on the challenge of human posture estimation in two dimensions, using both conventional and deep learning techniques, with an emphasis on its study's potential use in traffic-related settings. Recent approaches for estimating human poses are introduced, and a summary of how to extract bone joint points using deep learning techniques is provided. In conclusion, it elaborates on the present state of going beyond the bounds of single-computer computing resources and merging distributed architecture with deep learning to address the challenges and opportunities in human pose estimation. Human posture estimation has several technological applications, including the detection of driving behaviour and the analysis of fitness data.

articleTitle: The Progress of Face Recognition on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Face recognition is one of the most active research areas in computer vision and pattern recognition. It has many practical and commercial applications, including recognition, access control, forensics, and human-computer interaction. Therefore, it has received extensive attention from academia and industry. Face recognition technology includes feature extraction, feature selection, and classifier design. On this basis, this paper expounds the implementation methods and research progress of face recognition technology, analyzes the current mature face recognition algorithms, proposes distributed face recognition for the demand of large-scale real-time face recognition, and forecasts the development direction of face recognition.

articleTitle: Research on Quality Inspection and Imaging Method of Rebar in Concrete
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The durability of concrete structure can be judged effectively by measuring the diameter and buried depth of rebar in concrete. At present, most of the rebar quality detection methods are difficult to accurately and effectively detect the diameter and buried depth of the rebar, and the measurement accuracy and efficiency can't meet the actual demand. This paper presents a new method for quality inspection and imaging of rebar in concrete. The spatial distribution data of rebar and the magnetic induction intensity of reinforced concrete structures were obtained by the detection system. The measured magnetic induction intensity data is input into the trained GA-BP neural network model to predict the diameter and buried depth of the rebar. After obtaining the spatial distribution data and size data of the rebar in the concrete, the 3D distribution image of the rebar can be obtained by inputting the data into the 3D imaging module. The method was tested by casting a reinforced concrete structure in the laboratory. The results show that the error of this method can meet the actual demand and it has a good application prospect in the field of steel bar quality inspection.
